parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: NewPriority
parameters.description:
The new policy priority of the policy-based routing. Valid values: **1** to **100**.

A smaller policy priority value indicates a higher priority of the routing.

parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description: The next hop of the policy-based route.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The original policy priority of the policy-based routing. Valid values: **1** to **100**.

A smaller policy priority value indicates a higher priority of the routing.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RouteDest
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the policy-based route.

parameters.name: RouteSource
parameters.description: The source CIDR block of the policy-based route.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPN gateway.

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.description: The weight of the policy-based route.
